description: Read the current state of a scan: status, the ranked stories with their sources and source information, and any angles already proposed. Poll this after niche_signal_scan or niche_intelligence_query until the slate is ready.

include_unpicked.description: When true, return the full candidate set even after picks have been made. Default false (sparse: only the picked story / angle come back). Meaningful only with view='full'; ignored in view='status' (the lean envelope never carries the candidate slate).

since_status.description: Last status received. With wait and wait_until=change, return when it changes.

view.description: status returns a short progress summary. full returns the stories and available angles. Default full.

wait.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for progress, then return the current state. Default 0.

wait_for.description: Alias for wait_until. If both are supplied, wait_until takes precedence.

wait_until.description: With wait, return on change, an actionable checkpoint, or completion of synthesis.

name: niche_session_state
title: Read session state
